// dir: y
// want: analyzer "text-markers" declares "k", nothing reads it
// want: y run: a read in y is not attributable to one of [text-markers typo]
// want: y: params are used outside a reader call: *target
// want: y: params are used outside a reader call: ctx.Params("typo")
// want: y: params are used outside a reader call: params
// declared: text-markers=k
// with: core
package y

import "github.com/0b1-PulsarTech/pulsarules_codex/internal/analyzer/core"

func swap(ctx core.AnalysisContext, target *core.ParamSet) { *target = ctx.Params("typo") }

func run(ctx core.AnalysisContext) {
	params := ctx.Params("text-markers")
	swap(ctx, &params)
	_ = params.Int("k", 0)
}
